roleTitle: Senior Data Scientist, Credit Decisioning Models
jobDescription: The credit decisioning team builds the application scorecards and the affordability models used in the bank's consumer lending decisions. The Senior Data Scientist is the model owner of record for the scorecards: signs the model documentation submitted to model validation, supervises the two data scientists on the scorecard rebuilds, presents the models to the credit risk committee, and documents each model's limitations. The team requires a master's degree in statistics or a related quantitative field and prior experience as model owner of record for a model that passed independent validation. Reports to the head of credit decisioning; works with model validation, the credit risk committee secretariat and the lending product team.
requirements: Holds a master's degree in statistics or a related quantitative field.
Has been the model owner of record for a model that passed independent validation, signing the model documentation.
Supervises the data scientists on the scorecard rebuilds.
Presents the models to the credit risk committee.
Documents each model's limitations and monitoring boundaries.

evidence.text: Senior Data Scientist in the credit decisioning team of a consumer lender for four years, model owner of record for the two application scorecards, both of which passed independent validation in 2023 and 2025 with my signature on the model documentation.
Supervised the two data scientists on the scorecard rebuilds, reviewing their feature work and the rebuild test plans before each validation submission.
Presented both scorecards to the credit risk committee at approval and at the annual review, with the committee minutes recording the presentations.
Wrote the model limitation section and the monitoring boundary section of each scorecard's documentation, updated after each annual review.

Work sample: the signed model documentation for one scorecard with the validation sign-off page, the committee minutes extract for its approval and the degree certificate, with the model inventory identifiers as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said she holds an MSc in Statistics and was model owner of record for the two scorecards that passed validation; the years and the validation dates she gave match the resume.
Hiring manager pre-read: the head of credit decisioning asks that the packet cite the validation sign-off page, the committee minutes and the degree certificate.
